content:
paul_sales: Quick: midsize payments POC hitting two things — websocket proxy is splitting our streaming events causing malformed tool_call JSON, and they also see 429s under load. Need a short triage + guidance to procurement.

ivy_se: Most common: proxy slices frames mid-object. Short fixes: emit NDJSON (one JSON object per line) or use length-prefixed frames. Client should buffer until a full line/frame before JSON.parse().

dan_ops: For 429s we can grant a temporary concurrency bump for a vetted POC. Created ticket INF-9999 to track.

paul_sales: Can you share a tiny client reassembly snippet I can give their infra?

ivy_se: Sure — small JS shim: `let buf=''; onMsg(chunk){ buf += chunk; const idx = buf.indexOf('
'); if(idx===-1) return; const line = buf.slice(0,idx); buf = buf.slice(idx+1); const obj = JSON.parse(line); handle(obj); }` — use only as short-term; prefer proper framing at the server.

legal_jane: Procurement asked about SOC2 and KMS. We can provide SOC2 attestation and KMS integration docs; for residency recommend Dedicated/Private. I'll attach the packet.

paul_sales: Thanks — I'll send repro + the snippet and offer the temporary bump while they run the test. Updating when they confirm. :rocket:
